about: Layer of every Lean proof module, one layer per Rust crate it specifies, bottom to top. A module may import modules of its own layer or of layers below it (transitively through `below`). A module's layer is the layer whose `directory` holds it; `modules` names the modules outside every layer directory (the root barrel and the programs beside it). The pack layer has no models yet. `placements` records modules whose layer differs from the Rust crate that owns the code, and why. `exceptions` lists upward imports that remain because removing them would change a model. Checked by check-lean-import-layers.py.
